s1.text:
The mountain path narrows to a ledge barely wide enough for two. Wind howls through the gap, carrying the smell of sulfur and old fires.

Above you, the Brute's fortress clings to the cliff face like a scar. Below, nothing but fog and a very long fall.

The path forks — a steep climb up loose rock, or a narrow cave mouth that might cut through the mountain.
s1.ascensionText: You've been here before. The wind carries the same sulfur stink, the same distant rumble — but now there are fresh cracks in the cliff face. The Brute has been busy. The mountain itself feels angrier.
s1.imagePrompt: A narrow mountain ledge path with howling wind, a dark fortress clinging to cliffs above, fog below, a steep climb and a cave entrance splitting the path, epic dark fantasy landscape

choices.text: Enter the cave — shorter, maybe safer
Search the ledge for anything useful

s2a.text:
The climb burns your arms, but the view from the top reveals the Brute's arena — an open pit carved into the mountain itself, surrounded by broken columns and shattered shields.

You can see him from here. Massive. Restless. Slamming his fists into a stone pillar like it owes him money.
s2a.imagePrompt: View from a mountain top looking down into a carved arena pit with broken columns, a massive brute figure slamming stone pillars, epic scale, dark fantasy

choices.text: Watch his fighting stance — learn his patterns
Rest and recover before the descent

s2b.text:
Your grip slips on loose scree and you slide, catching yourself on a jutting root. Your hands are scraped, your pride stung.

But from this angle, you notice something — fresh tracks in the dust. Someone else came this way recently. And they left something behind: crude markings scratched into the rock.
s2b.imagePrompt: A hand gripping a root on a mountain slope with scraped knuckles, crude markings scratched into rock below, dust and scattered stones, tense moment, dark fantasy

choices.text: Read the markings — they might be warnings
Ignore them and push forward — no time for riddles

s2c.text:
The cave is dark and close. Water drips from somewhere above. The walls narrow until you're pressing through sideways.

Then the smell hits you — old meat and smoke. This is a den. Something lives here.

A low growl echoes from deeper in the dark.
s2c.imagePrompt: A narrow dark cave with dripping water, claustrophobic walls, faint red glow from deeper within, ominous atmosphere, something lurking, dark fantasy

choices.text: Stand your ground — whatever it is, face it
Back out slowly and take the cliff path
Try to sneak past in the darkness
The growl doesn't scare you — you roar back and charge into the dark

s3.text:
The arena entrance is a jagged mouth in the mountainside. No gate, no ceremony. Just raw stone and the sound of heavy breathing from within.

A last moment of stillness before everything becomes violence.
s3.imagePrompt: A jagged cave-like arena entrance in a mountainside, raw stone edges, ominous breathing mist coming from within, the calm before battle, epic dark fantasy

choices.text: Charge in — hit first, hit hard
Steady your breathing — endure what comes
Roll the dice — trust your luck
Rip a stone column from the ground — bring your own weapon to the pit

s4_final.text:
The Brute doesn't speak. He doesn't need to. His fists say everything.

He sees you and grins — a predator's grin, all teeth and no warmth.

"Subtlety is for cowards."
s4_final.ascensionText: The Brute stops mid-swing when he sees you. For the first time, something flickers behind those eyes — not fear, but recognition. He cracks his knuckles. "Good. I was hoping you'd come back. Last time was too easy."
s4_final.imagePrompt: A massive berserker brute grinning with predatory intent, scarred fists raised, mountain arena with broken columns behind, intimidating boss encounter, epic dark fantasy
